candidate.answerReason: The corresponding unit-circle point has coordinates \((\cos\theta,\sin\theta)\), so sine is the vertical coordinate.

methods.label: Unit-circle definition
methods.explanation: The cosine is the horizontal coordinate, and the sine is the vertical coordinate. The distance from this point on the unit circle to the origin is 1.
